title: False positive — documented last-write-wins without ETag on a single-writer resource
expected_feedback: No violations. Concurrency control is a [C] rule: optimistic locking with ETag/If-Match and last-write-wins are both legitimate resolutions. This resource is single-writer by construction, the loss scenario is a discarded UI toggle rather than a financial or inventory error, and the policy is written down — which is the reviewable requirement for S2. Risk trigger T4 (real multi-writer contention) is absent, so there is nothing to escalate. Reporting 'missing ETag/If-Match — concurrent updates silently overwrite' is a false positive here: it converts an unstated-policy rule into a mandatory-mechanism rule. The finding would be valid only if the policy were undocumented, or under T4, or on a resource where a lost update is material such as a balance, stock count, or permission grant.
must_not_flag: absence of ETag/If-Match reported as a defect on a documented single-writer resource
